correctness.rationale: For every a,b>0, c,d>=0 and initial state 11, the three-state absorbing generator yields L(s)=ab(2s+a+b+c+d)/[s^3+(2(a+b)+c+d)s^2+(a^2+3ab+b^2+(a+b)(c+d)+cd)s+ab(a+b+c+d)]. The denominator is positive at s>=0, and at fixed sum C the derivative of L(s) with respect to cd is strictly negative for s>0. AM-GM gives unique balanced optimum when C>0. Exact differentiation gives E[T]=H/B and Var[T]=(A/B)^2-2(2(a+b)+C)/B-4/K^2, each strictly increasing in product cd. Fresh symbolic generator inversion and exact rational examples passed. No unsupported ordinary stochastic order claim.

value.rationale: A motivated conservation planning constraint is the distribution of finite rescue capacity between two directions. The theorem identifies an exact invariance of the whole extinction-time distribution under swapped directions even for heterogeneous patches, as well as the unique simultaneous optimum for every Laplace discount parameter and both first two moments. This is structurally stronger than a single mean-time computation or one numerical counterexample and exposes an important tradeoff: maximizing persistence also maximizes absolute timing uncertainty. Meaning is restricted to successful colonization-rate budgets, and empirical transfer is not assumed.
